name: tiktok-ai-plugin
description: Drive your own TikTok account from the terminal with your browser session (no TikTok API app, no Apify): sign in with cookies; read profiles, videos and comments; publish videos and photo posts from TikTok Studio's own web flow as approved dry runs; run content, audit and research workflows on real account data; break down any TikTok into shots and script; and get read-only monetization and ads advice (Creator Rewards eligibility, Studio analytics, kill/keep/scale from an Ads Manager export). Planned: travel drafts and a local ComfyUI remake.

interface.shortDescription: Publish, read and analyze your TikTok account with your browser session
interface.longDescription: Sign in to TikTok with your own browser cookies and use the same web flows tiktok.com and TikTok Studio use: read profiles, videos and comments; publish videos and photo posts after an approved dry run; write hooks, scripts and captions; audit an account against its own median; research what works in your niche; break any TikTok into shots and script; and get read-only monetization and ads advice (Creator Rewards eligibility, Studio analytics, kill/keep/scale from an Ads Manager export). Planned, not built yet: travel drafts and a local ComfyUI remake.
defaultPrompt: Read my TikTok profile and my last 10 videos
Break down this TikTok into shots and script
Post this video to TikTok as only me (show me the dry run first)
